name: Sada (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sada town emblem in navy: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised letter V with a leaf.
history: Flag of the former town of Sada in Shimane Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-03-22. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 December 1956.

features.role: Sada town emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised letter V with a leaf
